description:
The queryable index of the agent economy: what is offered, what it costs, and whether it still works. An endpoint is never invented — every result exists in the corpus with a `last_seen`.

VALUE: The live index of paid x402 services, filterable by price, network and conformance — where new services are found.

PRICE: $0.02 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.

max_price_usd.description: Price ceiling in USD. An endpoint whose price we have NOT observed is EXCLUDED from a price-filtered query — an unknown price is not a cheap price.
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

min_uptime_pct.description: Uptime floor in percent. An endpoint we cannot yet score (fewer than 3 observations) is EXCLUDED — we do not guess.
min_uptime_pct.title: Min Uptime Pct

network.description: CAIP-2 network filter, e.g. 'eip155:8453'. Empty = any.
network.title: Network

query.description: Free-text capability match against the observed catalogue (path + summary + declared tags). Empty string = all. Supports a substring match and a token AND-match.
query.title: Query

require_conformance.description: When true, drop every endpoint whose conformance is 'insufficient_observations'.
require_conformance.title: Require Conformance
